additional_info.subject: Missing converters in DC1, DC2, DC3 & DC4
RE: 0427247 - ID0427247-DC/Si-D/TR-[MP/PN 170001120] Low power CRM:02023000624
additional_info.body:
Dear Yunus,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0427247 ﻿from the
Technical Support
to the
eMobility RC-
TR
SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s):
We have reviewed the logs for the reported period and observed that only one converter was operational, while the remaining converters from the groups DC1, DC2, DC3, and DC4 are missing or inactive. Consequently, the charger was only able to deliver 20 kW of power during charging.
I recommend a site visit to perform the following checks:
Please ensure all work complies with electrical safety protocols and applicable country-specific regulations and standards.
Inspect the charger on site, verifying the connections and operational status of the converters in all groups: DC1, DC2, DC3, and DC4.
Currently, only converters with serial numbers
2102312VGQKXM5001720
and
2102312VGQKXN9001710
are detected. You may swap these converters with adjacent units to determine if the issue follows the hardware.
If, after these steps, the converters are still found to be faulty, we recommend replacing them.
For ordering replacement converters, please use the following MLFB:
8EM5903-0AA01-0AA2 – Power Converter AC/DC 20 kW
Link to know more about spare parts:
https://support.industry.siemens.com/cs/document/109814736/sicharge-d-300-spare-part-list?dti=0&lc=en-WW
